acceptanceCriteria: batch-check and dogfood-finish refusals for a non-compiling base print the build error excerpt and a fix line
DOGFOOD.md documents the recovery for non-composing constituents
a test covers the refusal output
body: Observed 2026-10-19 on batch-1019b (#1178,#1179,#1184,#1187,#1188): constituents had Go name collisions (rubyName, rubyAssertion) and a main signature change, so every merges-only tip failed to build. dogfood-finish refused base-corvint-build-failed (script/dogfood-finish.sh:85-88, dogfood-check.sh:49-52 build ./cmd/corvint from BASE), and dogfood-batch-check refused current-tree-corvint-build-failed with no fix line. The batch-check advice (-X merges plus a sealed resolution change) is a dead end in this case. Expected: batch-check names the failing package/build error and points to the supported recovery (fix collisions on constituent branches, or a documented resolution path), and DOGFOOD.md documents it.
